subject: Enterprise access onboarding — SSO/SCIM sequence & policy map
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Enterprise access onboarding — SSO/SCIM sequence & policy map

Hi Alice,

Great to meet you yesterday. As discussed, this thread will be our working channel for the access controls portion of the onboarding (SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, IP allowlists, and service-account patterns / org policies). To keep things practical, propose the following agenda and immediate asks: 

1) Deliverables we need from Glacier before we kick configuration:
   - IdP metadata (SAML XML) or IdP URL + cert (for test & prod)
   - SCIM provisioning scope: which attributes you want synced, and whether you want group sync or only user create/update/delete
   - IP ranges (CIDR) for your firewall allowlist for both test and prod (if you plan network restrictions)
   - Preferred naming convention for service accounts and owned team contact for rotation (e.g., platform-team@glacierbank.com)

2) Redwood deliverables we will send back this week:
   - Preconfigured SAML SP metadata and test IdP endpoints
   - SCIM scope template (YAML) and example provisioning mappings
   - IP allowlist template CSV and recommended CIDR notes for hybrid setups
   - Implementation runbook with rollback steps (we'll attach a checklist)

Please attach your IdP metadata to your reply (glacier_idp_metadata.xml is fine) and indicate if you want SCIM to be one-way (provision-only) or two-way sync. If you have a target cutover week in mind, include it and we will align resources.

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.pdf (internal checklist we use for enterprise cutovers)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Enterprise access onboarding — SSO/SCIM sequence & policy map

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks — attaching our IdP metadata now (glacier_idp_metadata.xml). A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- SCIM: we want provision-only for now (create and update users; deletes should be disabled until we complete HR API gating). Group sync is desired but only for a single team scope initially (Engineering Ops).
- IP allowlist: for testing we will open 3 CIDRs (10.20.1.0/24, 34.72.16.0/28, 54.210.32.0/27). Production ranges will be tighter; we will share next week.
- Service accounts: our security ops requests that service accounts be prefixed with rbw- (e.g., rbw-provisioner) and tied to an owner email alias that is covered by our rotation policy.

Two asks for Redwood: can you provide an example of the SCIM attribute map you recommend, and the minimal SAML attributes you require for session mapping?

Regards,
Alice Jones
Director, Identity & Access
Glacier Bank

Attachment: glacier_idp_metadata.xml
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@glacierbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Nov 2028 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Enterprise access onboarding — SSO/SCIM sequence & policy map

Alice — thanks for the metadata and clarity. Answers below and next steps attached.

1) Minimal SAML attributes we require:
   - NameID (transient or persistent) mapped to user id
   - email (mail) 
   - givenName, sn (for display purposes)
   - optional: groups (if you plan group-based entitlements)

2) SCIM attribute map (attachment: scim-scope-skeleton.yaml) — we recommend the following minimal mapping:
   - userName -> userPrincipalName/email
   - name.givenName -> givenName
   - name.familyName -> familyName
   - active -> active (true/false)
   - groups -> group membership (defer full group sync until pilot)

3) IP allowlist — we will consume the test CIDRs you listed. For prod, recommend CIDRs <= /24 where possible; we will provide an allowlist template (ip-allowlist-template.csv) that you can drop into your change window.

4) Service account naming — Ben's template aligns with rbw- prefix. We'll include a short rotation anchor and requested owner alias in the runbook.

Proposed next steps / schedule (attached runbook):
   - Wed 21 Nov: SP metadata configured by Redwood in test tenant; customer to confirm browser SSO within 2 hours.
   - Thu 22 Nov: SCIM sandbox run with 10 test users; confirm attribute mapping and group mapping for EngOps only.
   - Fri 23 Nov: Lightweight security review and signoff; tentative cutover the following Tuesday (27 Nov) pending prod CIDRs.

Attachments: scim-scope-skeleton.yaml, ip-allowlist-template.csv (see Drive link for full runbook)

If that timeline works, Monica will schedule the test-window and I'll send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Kimberly
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Alice — confirmed on our side. I've created the test calendar blocks and invited your alias security_ops@glacierbank.com to the SAML test window on Wed 21 Nov 14:00–16:00 PST. Ben and I will join for provisioning.

Quick checklist we will validate during the window:
- SAML: metadata installed, cert thumbprint verified, NameID mapping validated, successful SP-initiated login flow
- SCIM: 10 test users provisioned, core attributes match, groups ignored except EngOps test group
- Network: test CIDRs reachable and allowed to Redwood test IPs (we'll provide our probe IPs pre-call)

I'll post meeting notes and attach the final onboarding-checklist.pdf after the call. Looking forward to the test.

Monica
